name: AppLinkCard
description: An app link's card drawn in the message, after the link's paragraph, where the app's answer lists one (a `card` item with `placement: "block"`): Raft's header with the app's identity, the item, and buttons that work by keyboard and touch. It never replaces the link. A `group`: label it with `aria-labelledby` pointing at its `AppLinkCardTitle`, so someone who tabs to one of its buttons hears which item the button acts on.

name: AppLinkCardActions
description: The app's buttons at the card's bottom end: at most two, the bordered one last, with a More menu (⋯) to their left for the rest.

name: AppLinkCardEyebrow
description: The app's id for the item, above the title. One line, truncated.

name: AppLinkCardHeader
description: Raft's row at the top: `AppLinkCardIcon`, `AppLinkCardName`, then `AppLinkCardHost`.

name: AppLinkCardHost
description: The link's host, after a "·". When it doesn't fit it loses its start, so the end, which says where the link goes, stays.

name: AppLinkCardIcon
description: The app's registered icon, the image Raft stores and serves: one child at 16px.

name: AppLinkCardMeta
description: One state in a neutral Badge, then muted details. Wraps when it runs out of room.

name: AppLinkCardName
description: The app's name as Raft stores it. One line, truncated.

name: AppLinkCardPlaceholder
description: The card's size while Raft fetches an answer it already knows lists a block card. Put the `AppLinkCardHeader` in it when the app is known; the item's lines and a button follow, as gray bars.

name: AppLinkCardTitle
description: The app's title for the item, up to 2 lines, then an ellipsis. Put a link to the item in it: the title opens the item, in the title's ink.
